detailed_description: The Dice Roller provides virtual dice for quick tabletop, classroom, and probability checks in the browser. Choose one of the visible dice buttons for D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, or D100, enter a number of dice from 1 to 20, add an optional numeric modifier, and press Roll Dice. The result shows the total, each individual die result, and the modifier when one is applied. A roll history panel keeps the latest rolls visible and can be cleared when you want to start a new session.
usage_steps: Select D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, or D100 from the dice buttons.
Enter how many dice to roll, up to 20 at a time.
Add a positive or negative modifier when your game or lesson needs one.
Click Roll Dice to generate the individual rolls and total.
Review recent results in the Roll History panel.
Use Clear History when you want to remove the current session history.
usage_examples: Roll 3D6 for a tabletop character attribute check.
Roll a D20 with a +5 modifier for a game action.
Use D100 for a percentile result during a role-playing session.
Show students several D6 rolls while discussing random outcomes.

faqs.question: Which dice are available?
faqs.answer: The tool includes D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, and D100.

faqs.question: How many dice can I roll at once?
faqs.answer: You can enter up to 20 dice for a single roll.

faqs.question: Can I add a modifier?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter a positive or negative modifier, and it will be included in the total.

faqs.question: Does it show individual results?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each die result is shown separately, along with the final total.

faqs.question: How long is the roll history?
faqs.answer: The page keeps the most recent rolls in the session history and shows the latest entries. You can clear it at any time.
